name: Unisound AI Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Unisound AI Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides artificial intelligence products and solutions in the People's Republic of China. The company offers the UniGPT foundation model and Beast Tooth intelligent agent platform, which provide smart customer service and smart marketing solutions; a one-stop smart rail transit intelligent agent application platform; a Cloud Customer Service system; Swift and Hummingbird AI chips; and speaking evaluation services for residential, commercial, and transportation applications.
